description: This file defines the 'Marketing' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension. It manages the marketing report functionality, including displaying report forms, saving settings, and generating marketing data reports with pagination and filtering options.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for managing the marketing reports in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering the report overview, filtering, and saving report settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the marketing report form page with breadcrumbs, configuration settings, and common page components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of marketing report settings, checking user permissions and returning success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the marketing report data view, including report listing and order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the marketing report list view with the current filters applied.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the marketing report data with filtering, sorting, pagination, and rendering the report list view.
